it.LOCAL_GUEST_DISABLED.message: Questo server non accetta un motore locale da un’app

en.LOCAL_GUEST_DISABLED.message: This server does not take a local engine from an app
en.LOCAL_GUEST_SOCKET_INVALID.message: The local engine socket is not valid: it must be a socket inside the app folder
en.kernel.motoreOspiteOccupato: The on-device model is busy with another job (a chat reply or a context summary); try again when it has finished.
en.kernel.motoreOspiteNonAperto: No local model is open in the app: open one from the model picker.
en.kernel.motoreOspiteCambiato: Another on-device model is open now; choose it again in Code.
en.kernel.motoreOspiteNonRisponde: The local engine in the app does not answer.
